planting.note: Propagate from stem cuttings rooted in warm, humid conditions; establish new divisions in spring so they have a full growing season to size up before winter's shorter days.

directions: Nepenthes 'Mixta' is a long-established hybrid pitcher plant that has been maintained in cultivation by carnivorous plant collectors for well over a century, producing sturdy, elongated pitchers that intergrade the traits of its large-pitchered parent species. Its vigor and sizable trap capacity are well documented in the carnivorous plant literature, including a published case of a cultivated specimen capturing a small bird. As a robust, lowland-leaning hybrid it tolerates a wider range of home and greenhouse temperatures than many pure highland Nepenthes, but still needs consistently high humidity and bright, filtered light to pitcher well. Water only with pure rainwater, distilled water, or reverse-osmosis water, and never fertilize the potting medium — let the plant catch its own insects instead.
